description:
Finish the closed error-code vocabulary cutover so production envelope construction cannot accept a raw code string or caller-selected status.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Every production `JsonError` construction site uses a typed `ErrorCode`; no production path calls `legacy_unregistered` or an equivalent raw-code/status constructor.
- [hard] REQ-02: The legacy raw-string constructor is removed from the production API, along with compatibility-only tests that preserve unregistered code emission.
- [hard] REQ-03: Every existing emitted code keeps its byte spelling and class-correct `ErrorCode::exit_code()` status, including the lowercase recovery code.
- [hard] REQ-04: Regression coverage fails if a production envelope code can bypass the enum or select a status independently of its code.
- [hard] REQ-05: The full Rust gate and independent code review pass with no scope drift into parser diagnostics or human output.

## Notes

This is a greenfield canonical cutover. There is no backward-compatibility requirement for an internal constructor that contradicts the typed vocabulary.
title: Complete the typed error-envelope constructor cutover
